history.summary: A freehold 904sqft 3BR at Trilive Kovan, listed at $1,769 psf — a ~6% discount to the $1,890 URA median, on a respectable 46-transaction series appreciating ~3.7%/yr. Roxy-Pacific build is acceptable but the development is ~80% dual-key/shoebox stock that skews the resale pool toward yield-chasing investors rather than family upgraders.
history.rating_rationale: Priced below URA median ($1,769 vs $1,890 psf) on solid txn depth (46), freehold tenure, and 770m to Kovan NE line — genuine positives. But D19 OCR appreciation of only 3.7%/yr is below the RCR alternatives in this batch, the dual-key-heavy development is a niche resale product, and a 904sqft 3BR is compact. Fair value, not a standout.
red_flags: Development is ~80% dual-key/shoebox — narrower family-buyer resale pool
catalysts: Kovan/Hougang amenities and NE line access
